summary: Game Your Game Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Stockholders Agreement with newly formed majority-owned subsidiary Altus Sports Group (ASG) and its four founders. Game Your Game holds 70% of ASG; founders hold 30% with four-year vesting. Initial funding of $200,000 committed by the parent. The agreement governs governance, founder vesting, repurchase rights, and consent matters. This is a subsidiary formation and governance arrangement, not a classic special situation. What to watch: ASG's operational progress and any future capital events for the subsidiary.
